text:
Priya Sharma: Heads up — Sr Infra candidate (ID: INF-482) got moved to Tue 3pm PT. Need two interviewers: backend + infra, and a scribe for notes/debrief. Zoom link in calendar, candidate prefers live system design + short take-home follow-up. Can anyone cover?
Jordan Lee: I can do backend but might need to shift if my deploy runs over. happy to cover if someone can ping me 30m prior. what's the expected debrief length?
Priya Sharma: Thanks Jordan. Debrief is usually 15 mins after the interview. I'll set a 35m slot (50m total) so small buffer.
Samir Patel: I can take infra. Quick Q — which rubric version? we have 1) technical depth 2) system design 3) communication 4) production-readiness. any weight changes for this role?
Priya Sharma: Use rubric v3 (link: https://intra.redwood/rubrics/sr-infra-v3). We weight technical depth 35%, system design 35%, prod-readiness 20%, comms 10%. Add any notes about risk areas in the "production-readiness" field.
Elena Gomez: I can join as backup if needed. Might be +10m late — teaching at 3pm.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: panel debrief template saved to 
https://intra.redwood/debrief-templates/panel-debrief.md
Please assign a scribe before the session.
Maya Chen: I'll be scribe for notes and action items. Will capture score highlights and any follow-ups. do we want to capture candidate consent for recording in notes?
Priya Sharma: Yes — candidate consented in their pre-interview form, mark "Consent: recording=yes" in the debrief. Thanks Maya.
Maya Chen: Cool, I'll also grab the candidate's PR to skim. anyone have the link?
Ajay Varma: PR link: https://git.redwood/infrateam/scale-prop/pulls/198 — focus on the scalability section and the memcache tradeoffs.
Jordan Lee: Thanks Ajay. For scoring ties, do we still use hiring committee tiebreaker or weight-based average?
Priya Sharma: Use weight-based average first. If the top two are within 0.1 points, escalate to hiring committee per process doc. Put 'escalate: yes' in the debrief if you think it's close.
Samir Patel: I'll bring the endpoint tests we ran yesterday — will paste a link to the test harness in thread before the interview.
Elena Gomez: Confirmed — I'll be there, likely +5-10.
Priya Sharma: Awesome. I'll update the calendar invite to include:
- Maya (scribe)
- Samir (infra)
- Jordan (backend)
- Elena (backup)
- Ajay (optional reviewer)
And drop the short debrief checklist below into the invite notes.
Priya Sharma: ```
Debrief checklist:
- Scores (1-4) per rubric section
- Top strengths and risks (2 bullets each)
- Follow-ups / take-homes assigned (owner + ETA)
- Recording consent noted
- Escalate flag if within 0.1 top-two
```
Priya Sharma: Thanks everyone — I'll ping 30m before to confirm. :thumbsup:
